title: OpenAI Now Produces 4B Images Weekly As Images 2.6 Access Expands
summary:
The latest iteration of the visual generation tools from the developer of ChatGPT has been rolled out globally to all subscription tiers across its mobile, desktop, and web platforms. This expanded access to Images 2.6 accompanies a surge in product adoption, with the platform now processing more than 4B image requests each week across its API and consumer apps, an increase from the 3B weekly requests recorded two months ago.

The update introduces the ability to create animated GIFs from prompts and save specific reference images for consistent reuse. While OpenAI reports that the new GPT-Image-2.6 Flare and Sunburst API models generate images 50% faster on average, some developers claim the Sunburst model's speeds are similar to the previous version. Additionally, the cost to generate images at medium quality via the API has increased to 3.3x the tokens per image compared to the prior generation.

BREAKING: GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst by @OpenAI is ranked #1 on Image Arena, overtaking its predecessor Image 2.5 Sunburst. GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst & Flare have also redefined the Preference vs Speed Pareto frontier for both Image Generation and Image Editing capabilities.

There is currently no model that is both better and faster than the GPT Image 2.6 models on both frontiers.

Key Data Points:
- #1 in the Portraits, Architecture, & Typography (GPT Image 2.6 Flare)
- #1 in Product & Landscape (GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst)
- 2.6 Flare is 2.6× faster than its predecessor for both Image and Image Editing
- 2.6 Sunburst is 1.15× faster than its predecessor for both Image and Image Editing

Congrats to the @OpenAI team for establishing a new SOTA on Preference vs Speed!

GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst and Flare by @OpenAI are here, running almost 2x faster than GPT Image 2.5.

In the Image Edit Arena, Sunburst (Medium) is #3 with 1476 pts, and Flare (Medium) #5 with 1462 pts. See leaderboard in thread.

With this release, @OpenAI remains the #1 lab in both arenas and holds all top 5 Text-to-Image spots!

GPT Image 2.6 lands on Arena with enhanced speed. According to @OpenAI, Sunburst (Medium) and Flare (Medium) are more than 2x faster than GPT Image 2.5 while maintaining the lead over competing labs. They report similar quality to Image 2.5, with enhanced photorealism, greater editing consistency, and a dynamic reasoning level that enables latency as low as 5 seconds.
